red-dead-redemption-2.title: Red Dead Redemption 2
red-dead-redemption-2.platformNote: PS5 and Xbox Series X|S play the PS4/Xbox One version through backward compatibility.
red-dead-redemption-2.tagline: The frontier, rendered in blood and starlight.
red-dead-redemption-2.shortDescription: Rockstar’s sprawling western follows an outlaw gang as the age of the gunslinger gives way to law, industry, and loss.
red-dead-redemption-2.overview: An open-world western built on staggering period detail, Red Dead Redemption 2 trades power fantasy for the slow, muddy reality of life in a vanishing America. Its world rewards attention: conversations, weather, wildlife, and consequence all matter.
red-dead-redemption-2.story: America, 1899. The Van der Linde gang is on the run after a robbery goes wrong, pursued by federal agents and bounty hunters. Arthur Morgan, a senior enforcer, must keep his found family alive while questioning the dream that holds them together. The frontier is closing, and the gang’s choices shrink with it.
red-dead-redemption-2.spoiler: The story’s second half is best discovered unspoiled. Character fates and the gang’s final direction are shaped by loyalty, honor, and time.

gameplay.title: Combat
gameplay.body: Cover shooting, contextual melee, and Dead Eye slow-motion create deliberate, weighty gunfights.

gameplay.title: Exploration
gameplay.body: Ride, hunt, fish, and stumble into stranger encounters across a reactive frontier.

gameplay.title: Missions
gameplay.body: Story jobs mix scripted set pieces with camp life, chores, and quiet character scenes.

gameplay.title: Movement
gameplay.body: Animation-led locomotion and horse bonding make travel feel physical rather than instant.

gameplay.title: Progression
gameplay.body: Camp upgrades, weapon maintenance, crafting, and a satchel system reward preparation.

gameplay.title: Multiplayer
gameplay.body: Red Dead Online offers posse play, frontier roles, and a shared open world.

features.title: A living simulation
features.body: Wildlife, weather, schedules, and NPC routines persist with or without the player.

features.title: Honor system
features.body: Actions alter dialogue, prices, and encounters, nudging Arthur’s self-image.

features.title: Cinematic presentation
features.body: Long takes, dynamic music, and a restrained camera give the story an elegiac tone.

features.title: Detail as design
features.body: Weapon wear, horse care, and camp upkeep turn mundane tasks into role-play.

minimum.gpu: NVIDIA GTX 770 2 GB / AMD R9 280 3 GB

recommended.gpu: NVIDIA GTX 1060 6 GB / AMD RX 480 4 GB
